events.title: Golden Makers Harvest — Free Family Make-and-Take
events.location: Foothills Art Center Creative Campus, 809 15th Street, Golden, CO 80401
events.cost: Free ($0 entry for five people); maker-led make-and-take activities advertised within free community event; optional Maker Market purchases extra. Separate activity supplies fee not stated.
events.age: All ages, public community event. Event directs visitors to organizer for RSVP; mandatory RSVP/remaining places not confirmed.
events.description: Nov 14 one-evening special gathering offering hands-on create-and-take craft experiences for all ages led by local makers at Foothills Art Center, unlike routine paid classes. City destination calendar states free, gives exact venue/date/hours, and identifies organizer Golden Makers. RSVP link advertised but organizer site inaccessible during research, so no guaranteed spot. Useful to 2026 Colorado residents, not 2027-2028 visiting family. Reference official local event calendar.
